funnel_definition: Nested S1 reference-symbol hypothesis; S2 supported on a localized symbol; S3 successful edit in a reference file; S4 nonempty retained candidate; Sec terminal-verified security pass among S4. Symbol overlap is an evaluator-side proxy, not proof the supported hypothesis caused the edit.

historical_diagnostics.note: Detailed S1/S2 gap classification, manual semantic taxonomy and counterfactual rescue are frozen historical cohorts. Full funnel above includes all 1548 cells per investigator.

taxonomy.coding: Manual retrospective source/patch/assertion review; no independent second reviewer; symbol overlap includes incidental reference hunks

rows.candidate_mechanism: Filters underscore-prefixed session keys instead of enforcing expiry.
rows.observed_failure: Expired encrypted session still returns WARNING!; expected an empty body.
rows.reference_mechanism: Reference computes now-created and drops session_data when age exceeds max_age.

rows.candidate_mechanism: Recognizes decompression exhaustion, but checks a private 10 MB output limit only after zlib.decompress has allocated the output.
rows.observed_failure: Official test stops at missing public size-limit constant; the after-allocation check also fails to bound decompression work.
rows.reference_mechanism: Reference exports default_max_compressed_size and checks compressed input length before decompression.

rows.candidate_mechanism: Recognizes unsafe paths, but bans all absolute paths and .. without run-artifact containment, file-URI policy, or URI-classifier repair.
rows.observed_failure: Valid source requests return 500 instead of 200; URI test also accepts file://myhostname/path/to/file.
rows.reference_mechanism: Reference allows contained run artifacts, rejects file URIs by default with an explicit override, and repairs local-host recognition.

rows.candidate_mechanism: Recognizes empty/singleton reflection edges, but sends an empty axis through edge-padding helpers.
rows.observed_failure: Edge helper indexes an empty axis, raising IndexError instead of the expected ValueError.
rows.reference_mechanism: Reference raises ValueError only for nonzero padding on an empty axis and skips zero padding.
rows.verified_log_excerpt: IndexError: index 0 is out of bounds

rows.candidate_mechanism: Recognizes malformed redirect URLs but adds a whitespace-only netloc test.
rows.observed_failure: Browser-style backslash hostname is still accepted.
rows.reference_mechanism: Reference normalizes backslashes, rejects triple slashes, and rejects scheme-without-host URLs.

rows.candidate_mechanism: Adds password encoding and bcrypt byte-length checks; does not repair duplicate normalized usernames.
rows.observed_failure: collisionNormalized remains in the database. This is a false-positive localization proxy, not a repair of the security-bearing reference function.
rows.reference_mechanism: Security-relevant reference logic is in _check_passwords: back up the DB and remove non-normalized duplicate entries. The authenticate hunk only changes quote style.

rows.candidate_mechanism: Normalizes lexical .. segments and rejects absolute paths, but does not resolve symlinks or validate the resolved path against the root.
rows.observed_failure: Two rejected lexical escapes return 404 where 400/403 is required; symlink escape returns 200, so failure is not merely response-contract wording.
rows.reference_mechanism: Reference realpath-resolves both paths, checks containment, and returns 403 on escape.

rows.candidate_mechanism: Focuses on one-letter Windows schemes and tests a colon in parsed.path, leaving remote file-host classification unchanged.
rows.observed_failure: file://myhostname/path/to/file is still classified as local.
rows.reference_mechanism: Reference treats scheme-less paths as local before applying host restrictions to file URIs.

rows.candidate_mechanism: Adds a missing-run_id rejection but does not validate experiment artifact URI fragments or ensure the run artifact URI is local.
rows.observed_failure: The test stops in experiment creation with INTERNAL_ERROR / Expected str, got bytes instead of INVALID_PARAMETER_VALUE. It never establishes that this partial repair fixes the intended bypass.
rows.reference_mechanism: Reference rejects fragments in _create_experiment and checks is_local_uri(run.info.artifact_uri) before filesystem containment.

rows.candidate_mechanism: Adds a 1 MB body limit after reading the body, instead of enforcing media-type-dependent JSON parsing.
rows.observed_failure: JSON-looking text/form/XML payloads are accepted with 200 instead of rejected with 422.
rows.reference_mechanism: Reference parses JSON only for application/json or application/*+json; other bodies remain bytes for validation.

rows.candidate_mechanism: Recognizes HQL schema injection and adds a regex guard only when the explicit schema argument is truthy.
rows.observed_failure: Test sets conn.schema to default; and omits the schema argument. The guard is skipped and no exception is raised.
rows.reference_mechanism: Reference first resolves schema = schema or conn.schema, then rejects unsafe characters before subprocess execution.

rows.candidate_mechanism: Chooses UTF-8 explicitly but leaves strict decoding of malformed bytes.
rows.observed_failure: Non-UTF-8 input still raises UnicodeDecodeError. This is an error-handling contract failure in the benchmark.

rows.candidate_mechanism: Recognizes ambiguous request framing but repairs Transfer-Encoding combinations only.
rows.observed_failure: Malformed and duplicate Content-Length tests still reach self.assertTrue(False): no ParsingError.
rows.reference_mechanism: Reference raises ParsingError instead of converting invalid Content-Length to zero.

rows.candidate_mechanism: Rejects duplicate parameter names instead of fixing end-of-string matching.
rows.observed_failure: Six trailing-newline route cases do not raise Resolver404.
rows.reference_mechanism: Reference uses \Z for generated routes and fullmatch for endpoint regexes ending in $.

rows.candidate_mechanism: Uses urljoin plus same-host/http(s) validation but leaves browser/Python disagreement for excessive leading slashes.
rows.observed_failure: The backslash/slash hostname case is still accepted; the security suite reports one failure.
rows.reference_mechanism: Reference normalizes multiple slashes after scheme or at the beginning before URL parsing.

taxonomy.selection: 15 distinct tasks, excluding all 18 task IDs in DEV_CASE_KEYS; retained exact-reference-patch-symbol edits, recognized FuncPass and SecFail, functional-pass/security-fail baselines; maximum task diversity, not a random sample
